verdict.rationale: An IP filing and search portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as AI-assisted prior-art or similarity suggestions, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The search tools, first action estimator and docketing features are conventional, non-AI capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
